root_cause_evidence.authoring_path: fresh_holdout_24._seed_pack creates embedded APPROVED reviews and frozen packs.
root_cause_evidence.consumer_path: compose_execution_artifacts retrieves those rows and constructs twelve items.
root_cause_evidence.late_review_path: _apply_independent_holdout_audit runs only after item construction and invalidates all provisional rows.

canonical_metric_definitions.feature_maps_approved: Distinct maps with a final independent APPROVED verdict and a pinned reviewed hash.
canonical_metric_definitions.seeds_approved: Distinct proposals with a final independent APPROVED verdict; authored or embedded provisional statuses do not count.
canonical_metric_definitions.contrast_ready: Frozen coherent contrast sets whose key, seeds, relations, anchors, and second-key checks all passed.
canonical_metric_definitions.stems_generated: Actual generator callback executions after assert_generation_ready returned PASS.
canonical_metric_definitions.final_reviewed: Generated items from a valid generation path that received final review.
canonical_metric_definitions.rejected: Validly generated and final-reviewed items with a REJECTED verdict.
canonical_metric_definitions.no_safe_item: Attempted opportunities terminated before valid generation.

taxonomy_provenance_limit: The 12 pre-pack rejections explicitly record co-key/alias. The later review serialized only 33 REJECTED and 3 UNCERTAIN seed IDs, not per-seed reasons; those 36 fail closed as INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION.

contract_gap_notes.AUTHORING_GATE_MISSING: Thirty-six packed rows received author-embedded approval without a separately identified independent reviewer.
contract_gap_notes.OTHER: Twelve co-key/alias proposals were already removed by the author-side pre-pack filter.
